tools.name: identify_patient
tools.description: Find the patient record. The number they're calling from is tried automatically — try that before asking for anything. dob is YYYY-MM-DD. Returns masked candidates only.

tools.name: verify_identity
tools.description: Verify the caller. Needs full name and date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD); add a second factor — their zip or the last four of the phone on file — if the tool asks for one. Never ask for a Social Security number. After the third failure this locks; when it does, stop and offer the front desk or a callback.

full_name.description: Full legal name, given name then family name.

second_factor.description: ZIP (5 digits) or last four of the phone on file.

tools.name: get_patient_summary
tools.description: Load everything the chart already knows — name, language, home office, last visit, upcoming appointments, insurance, balance, card on file, portal status, open orders and clinical flags. Call this the moment verification passes, before handing off.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Offices by zip OR location_id: address, floor, suite, hours, services, transit, parking, and whether the office does cosmetic work. The only source of an office address, floor or location_id. Map caller names to loc_park_ave, loc_brooklyn_heights, or loc_windermere.

location_id.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

tools.name: classify_visit_request
tools.description: Map the visit to an appointment type. Pass visit_class (cosmetic | mohs | allergy | medical), is_new_patient when you know, and urgency when spreading/painful/bleeding. Always call this before find_slots — it is what stops a Mohs consult being booked with a PA.

visit_class.description: Closed visit class. cosmetic = injectables/lasers/peels; mohs = skin cancer / Mohs; allergy = hives/testing/shots; medical = everything else.

is_new_patient.description: True if they have never been seen at Straus.

urgency.description: urgent for spreading, painful, bleeding, or infected complaints; routine otherwise.

tools.name: find_slots
tools.description: Open appointment slots at the given offices. Offer two or three, never a list.

items.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

location_ids.description: One or more office ids to search.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Create the appointment. Only after you have read back the day, the time, the office WITH THE FLOOR and the provider with credentials, and the caller said yes. Description is derived from appointment_type_code — do not pass one.

location_id.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

provider_id.description: Provider id from find_slots or get_patient_summary: prov_chen, prov_ruiz, or prov_patel.

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move an existing appointment. This is an update, never a cancel-then-rebook, and it never costs anything — say so. Always offer this before cancelling.

appointment_id.description: Appointment id as a decimal string, e.g. "1".

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel. Leave fee_disclosed_and_accepted false the first time: if a fee applies the tool will hand you the exact wording to say. Say it, offer a different time instead, and only call again with true if they still want to cancel. Always offer to rebook after.

appointment_id.description: Appointment id as a decimal string, e.g. "1".

cancellation_reason_code.description: Why the visit is being cancelled.

fee_disclosed_and_accepted.description: False on the first call. True only after they accepted the spoken fee.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Put them on the earlier-appointment list. Required: appointment_type_code, location_ids, earliest, latest.

items.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

location_ids.description: Offices they will take an earlier opening at.

tools.name: schedule_allergy_service
tools.description: Allergy visits: skin_testing, patch_testing, food_challenge, allergy_shot, drops_pickup, asthma_eval, immunotherapy_buildup. Say the prep instructions, the observation time after a shot, and the linked return visits out loud.

location_id.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

tools.name: check_plan_accepted
tools.description: Carrier by OFFICE by provider. Pass carrier as a slug (aetna, unitedhealthcare, cigna, bcbs, medicare, medicaid, oscar_health, other) and location_id as loc_park_ave | loc_brooklyn_heights | loc_windermere. If must_not_assert is true you may not say they're covered or not covered: say required_script and create a callback. If accepted is no, say so plainly.

carrier.description: Payer slug. Map caller names: Aetna → aetna, UnitedHealthcare → unitedhealthcare, Blue Cross → bcbs, Oscar Health → oscar_health, Medicaid → medicaid. Unknown payers → other.

location_id.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

provider_id.description: Provider id from find_slots or get_patient_summary: prov_chen, prov_ruiz, or prov_patel.

tools.name: run_eligibility_check
tools.description: Live copay, deductible and coinsurance. Only if they gave you a member ID. If the payer doesn't answer, say you couldn't get the number — never guess at a copay.

carrier.description: Payer slug. Map caller names: Aetna → aetna, UnitedHealthcare → unitedhealthcare, Blue Cross → bcbs, Oscar Health → oscar_health, Medicaid → medicaid. Unknown payers → other.

member_id.description: Member or subscriber id, letters and digits only.

service_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the visit being checked.

tools.name: capture_insurance_update
tools.description: Take new or changed insurance by voice, then send a secure link for card photos. Never ask for a Social Security number.

carrier.description: Payer slug. Map caller names: Aetna → aetna, UnitedHealthcare → unitedhealthcare, Blue Cross → bcbs, Oscar Health → oscar_health, Medicaid → medicaid. Unknown payers → other.

member_id.description: Member or subscriber id, letters and digits only.

group_number.description: Group number, letters and digits only.

subscriber_relationship.description: Who the subscriber is relative to the patient.

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: The balance and the line items behind it.

tools.name: explain_charge
tools.description: The approved explanation for a charge. Say approved_script as written — do not improvise a billing explanation.

tools.name: send_payment_link
tools.description: Text a secure payment link. The only payment path — never take a card by voice.

tools.name: offer_financing
tools.description: CareCredit for a balance they can't pay at once. Over two hundred fifty dollars. Required: amount_cents.

tools.name: request_fee_waiver
tools.description: Open a review of a missed-visit fee. You do NOT waive it yourself. Required: fee_line_item_id. Say the SLA the tool gives you out loud.

fee_line_item_id.description: Fee line to send for review. You do not waive it.

tools.name: quote_cosmetic_service
tools.description: The only source of a cosmetic price. service is botox | filler | chemical_peel | microneedling. If it returns a range you may say that range and must add that the consult settles the number. If it returns no range, never invent a number.

tools.name: book_cosmetic_consult
tools.description: Book the consult. Leave policy_acknowledged false the first time — the tool hands you the exact four policy lines to say (deposit, 72 hours, forfeited, balance due). Say them, get a real yes, then call again with true.

service_interest.description: Cosmetic services they want discussed at the consult.

location_id.description: Office id. Map caller names: Park Avenue → loc_park_ave, Brooklyn Heights → loc_brooklyn_heights, Windermere → loc_windermere.

provider_id.description: Provider id from find_slots or get_patient_summary: prov_chen, prov_ruiz, or prov_patel.

policy_acknowledged.description: False on the first call. True only after they accepted the four policy lines.

tools.name: request_rx_refill
tools.description: Open a refill request. This NEVER approves a refill. Required: medication_name. Optional: pharmacy_phone (E.164), last_fill_date (YYYY-MM-DD). Follow the route it returns; on a no_recent_visit hard stop, offer to book the visit on this call.

tools.name: get_results_status
tools.description: STATUS of pathology, lab or allergy testing — never the content. Required: order_type (pathology | lab | allergy). Say approved_script. If they push for what the results say, hold the line warmly every time and create a clinical message instead.

order_type.description: Which kind of result they are asking about.

tools.name: create_clinical_message
tools.description: Task the clinical team. priority stat for anything emergent, urgent otherwise. Say the callback_window it returns out loud.

priority.description: stat for anything emergent, urgent otherwise, routine for results follow-up.

tools.name: search_practice_kb
tools.description: Look up a grounded Straus answer. topic is hours | directions | portal | fees | services. Only say what this returns — if it finds no source, do not make one up.

topic.description: KB bucket. hours = open/close; directions = parking/transit; portal = login; fees = cancel/no-show; services = what we treat.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Text the caller. template_id is one of appointment_confirmation, portal_activation, payment_link, insurance_card_upload, directions, cosmetic_deposit.

tools.name: send_portal_activation
tools.description: Send the portal activation link when the portal isn't active. Optional: channel (sms | email).

channel.description: Delivery channel for the activation link.

tools.name: create_callback_task
tools.description: Promise a callback with a real, tracked SLA. queue is billing, clinical, front_desk, cosmetic or records. Say the spoken_commitment out loud, verbatim.

priority.description: Callback SLA. routine is the default.

tools.name: transfer_to_identity
tools.description: Invisible handoff to Identity & Verification when chart access is required before the real work. Pass next_intent (scheduling | billing | clinical | coverage | cosmetic) so identity knows where to continue. Call history is already visible — do not pass a summary.

next_intent.description: Where identity should continue after verification.

tools.name: transfer_to_scheduling
tools.description: Invisible handoff to Scheduling & Access for booking, rescheduling, cancelling, waitlist, or allergy visits. Call history is already visible — no arguments.

tools.name: transfer_to_coverage
tools.description: Invisible handoff to Coverage & Benefits for plan acceptance, referrals, eligibility, or capturing a new insurance card. Call history is already visible — no arguments.

tools.name: transfer_to_cosmetic
tools.description: Invisible handoff to Cosmetic Concierge for Botox, fillers, lasers, peels, cosmetic pricing, or cosmetic consult booking. Call history is already visible — no arguments.

tools.name: transfer_to_billing
tools.description: Invisible handoff to Billing & Payments for balances, charge explanations, payment links, financing, or fee waivers. Caller must already be identity-verified. Call history is already visible — no arguments.

tools.name: transfer_to_clinical
tools.description: Invisible handoff to Clinical Liaison for results status, refills, nurse messages, prior auth, portal, or records. Caller must already be identity-verified. Call history is already visible — no arguments.

tools.name: transfer_to_human
tools.description: Transfer the caller to a human. Use only when (1) the caller asks for a human, or (2) after telling them to call 911 and saying you are transferring them for a clinical emergency. Required: destination and reason enums. Call history is already visible — do not pass a summary.

reason.description: Why this is leaving the voice agent.

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: End the call once the caller is done, or immediately if it's spam or a wrong number. Say goodbye first. reason is caller_done | spam | wrong_number.
